# Brain Juice Collective

> A Singapore-based social impact collective delivering community-driven solutions through consultancy, education, innovation labs, and responsible business transformation.

Brain Juice Collective combines strategy, design thinking, and behavioral science to help organizations and communities solve complex social challenges. Their work spans public engagement, corporate impact strategy, workplace culture transformation, and youth innovation programs across Southeast Asia.

## Key Topics

- Social Impact
- Community Engagement
- Responsible Innovation
- Corporate Impact DNA
- ESG Strategy
- Behavioral Design
- Stakeholder Engagement
- Work Culture Transformation
- Youth Wellbeing
- Design Thinking
- Public Engagement
- Community-Driven Solutions
- Employee Experience
- Innovation Labs
- Purpose-Driven Business

## Core Organization

- [Home](https://brainjuice.sg): Brain Juice Collective homepage showcasing community-driven solutions and social impact work
- [Who We Are](https://brainjuice.sg/who-we-are): About Brain Juice Collective: mission, values, and social DNA approach to projects
- [Responsible Innovation](https://brainjuice.sg/responsible-innovation): Responsible Innovation framework and approach to ethical, sustainable business practices

## Service Offerings

- [Public Engagement](https://www.brainjuice.sg/focus-areas/public-engagement): Public engagement services: community mapping, stakeholder engagement, participatory design
- [Corporate Impact DNA](https://www.brainjuice.sg/focus-areas/corporate-impact-dna): Corporate impact strategy and ESG branding services for purpose-driven businesses
- [Work Culture & Transformation](https://www.brainjuice.sg/focus-areas/work-culture-transformation): Organizational transformation and workplace culture change services for teams
- [Consultancy](https://brainjuice.sg/our-ecosystem/consultancy): Consultancy services: strategy, insights, and impact-driven business solutions
- [Education](https://brainjuice.sg/our-ecosystem/education): Education and learning experience design for corporate training and leadership development
- [Innovation Lab](https://brainjuice.sg/our-ecosystem/lab): Innovation lab services: workshops, hackathons, mentorship, and venture support
- [Marketing and Events](https://brainjuice.sg/our-ecosystem/marketing-and-events): Marketing and event production services for community engagement and brand strategy

## Case Studies & Impact

- [Case Studies](https://brainjuice.sg/case-studies): Case studies showcasing Brain Juice Collective's social impact projects and solutions
- [Healthier Schools at South West](https://brainjuice.sg/case-studies/how-we-made-healthier-living-relatable-for-students-through-healthier-schools-at-south-west): Case study: Healthier Schools program using interactive activities and storytelling
- [Plate with Purpose - National Day Heartland Celebrations](https://brainjuice.sg/case-studies/how-we-reimagined-community-volunteering-for-the-national-day-heartland-celebrations): Case study: Community volunteering activation with AR experience
- [Glow Up with 42 - Youth Wellbeing](https://brainjuice.sg/case-studies/how-we-helped-young-people-build-sustainable-wellbeing-habits-with-glow-up-with-42): Case study: Youth wellbeing program using behavioral design
- [Youth Mental Health Innovation Fellowship](https://brainjuice.sg/case-studies/how-we-fostered-a-safe-and-collaborative-environment-for-youth-mental-health-innovation): Case study: Youth mental health innovation fellowship with Institute of Mental Health
